title: City park billboard

prompts.shared: photo of a green city park path with joggers and benches, a large billboard beside the path, overcast daylight
prompts.prompt_a: photo of a green city park path with joggers and benches, a large billboard beside the path, overcast daylight, billboard shows a leaf green bicycle on a green background
prompts.prompt_b: photo of a green city park path with joggers and benches, a large billboard beside the path, overcast daylight, billboard shows bright orange headphones on an orange background
prompts.negative: text, letters, words, watermark, signature, real brand logo, blurry, lowres, deformed, cropped

manifest.rng_order: numpy.random.default_rng(seed): standard_normal(latent_numel) initial latent (x init_noise_sigma), then per step GaussianTape.draw(rng, latent_numel) = RandomTape.draw (4 uniforms: branch, token_a, token_b, contest) followed by standard_normal(latent_numel)

outcome_note: clip:* values are CLIP zero-shot label probabilities: a noisy heuristic for brand visibility, not ground truth.
